newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU Court upholds 75 mln ECU fine against Tetra Pak.
newsitem.headline: EU Court upholds 75 mln ECU fine against Tetra Pak.

text.p: The European Court of Justice rejected on Thursday an appeal by Swedish carton marker Tetra Pak against a 75 million European currency units fine imposed on the company by the European Commission in 1991, a court official said.
"The Court dismisses the apppeal," the official told Reuters. Tetra Pak was condemned to pay the costs involved in the court action.

The Commission decided to fine Tetra Pak in July 1991 after it concluded the company had broken European Union competition rules by "bullying" rivals and slashing prices to control the European market for over a decade.
An earlier attempt by Tetra Pak to have the fine annulled had already been dismissed by the European Court of First Instance, the EU's lower court.
